description: Bold and hardy, with keen senses and deep intuition.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Sees in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Hit point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 every time a level is gained.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor.
